card.name: Hyperglycemia and other hyper- warning headings
card.fires_on: The start of the word hyper (as in hyperglycemia, hyperactivity, hyperimmunoglobulin) right after a section number or list punctuation in warnings. Also the word including before a list of infections.

modes.label: Hyper- starting a term
modes.description: The opening piece of hyperglycemia-type words, often at the start of a numbered warning heading.
modes.example: antipsychotic drugs have been associated with metabolic changes including hyperglycemia, dyslipidemia, and weight gain (5.5)<< Hyper>>glycemia and Diabetes Mellitus :

modes.label: including before infections
modes.description: The word including introducing a list of invasive fungal infections.
modes.example: ab-adaz use and during therapy. Initiate treatment for latent TB prior to Adalimumab-adaz use. • Invasive fungal infections,<< including>> histoplasmosis, cocc
